title: Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one
summary: For every fixed $`0\lt q\lt 1`$, we prove that the Dobrushin interface of the square-lattice random-cluster model at its self-dual parameter converges to chordal SLE κ , where $`\kappa=4\pi/\arccos(-\sqrt q/2)\in(6,8)`$. The approximating domains are simple closed nearest-neighbor lattice polygons with distinct marked vertices, whose marked boundary parametrizations converge uniformly to those of a bounded smooth Jordan domain.
